classification: outcome-informed architecture calibration on frozen T-071A seeds; design evidence only

controller.variance_weight_rule: unit coefficient on the observable covariance-of-mean proxy
controller.rollback_margin_rule: minus one half of the frozen gain

descriptive_criteria.Q1: finite complete reuse of all 432 cells and 32 T-071A seeds
descriptive_criteria.Q2: at least 5 percent geometric cumulative-risk improvement on nonstationary cells
descriptive_criteria.Q3: strict improvement in at least 55 percent of nonstationary cells
descriptive_criteria.Q4: at least 2 percent improvement in both nonstationary schedule families
descriptive_criteria.Q5: nonnegative improvement in every delay group
descriptive_criteria.Q7: exactly 240 learning transitions, zero extra probe transitions, and at most 18 message units
descriptive_criteria.Q8: positive continuous collaboration and finite nonnegative safety debt
descriptive_criteria.Q9: mean projected-gradient iterations per recipient-decision at most 35 and hard maximum at most 50
